verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents Verification Flows, a saved configuration that can be reused across integration interfaces, and a flow's static link can verify any number of users. That is a shareable link an ops lead could send without new engineering work. Community users also report sending guests a link that they complete easily. The evidence never mentions a QR code option, never states that flows and links are created without code (for example, from the Dashboard), and does not address one-off, per-person sends versus a shared static link. missing for 10: QR code support, explicit no-code/Dashboard creation of flows and links, per-recipient one-off link sending, independent hands-on corroboration of ops-only setup.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller

citations.quote: You can use a flow’s static link to verify any number of your users.
Flows provide a way to save and reuse the same configuration across all of your integration interfaces.
Given that our guests have trouble even following a link for check-in the identity product has some great UX, they rarely get stuck on it.
